summary: Teachers say goodbye to graduating students with personal notes, advice walls, photo booths and a short speech with snacks.
realLife: An education article lists five ways: a note to each student on something specific, an advice wall of sticky notes, a photo booth with prints, a class poem and a farewell speech with treats.
sources: Edutopia, five ways to say goodbye to graduating students: https://www.edutopia.org/blog/five-ways-to-say-goodbye-graduating-students-rebecca-alber/
inGame: A school and graduation or last day at school; the tie between the player and the teacher decides who gives a note.
